records.title: Odoo version still unknown, ask IT
records.summary: Nobody knows the Odoo version or edition yet; this note was meant to last only until IT answered.

records.title: Temporary: CI runs on Linux only
records.summary: Until macOS runners were confirmed, CI was planned for Linux only; superseded in practice by the macOS matrix.

records.title: A service account with an inbox folder is the simplest Google auth
records.summary: Google ingestion uses a service account that can read one shared inbox folder, not per-user OAuth.

records.title: Tim menulis dalam bahasa Inggris dan Indonesia
records.summary: Catatan proyek bisa ditulis dalam bahasa Inggris atau Indonesia, jadi pencarian harus lintas bahasa.

records.title: Candidate embedding families: multilingual-e5 and BGE-M3
records.summary: The shortlist for the local multilingual model was multilingual-e5 small/base and BGE-M3, plus a hosted option.

records.title: The MCP TypeScript SDK is the official one
records.summary: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk is the official TypeScript SDK and the planned base for the MCP server.

records.title: Default briefing budget is 4000 tokens
records.summary: Briefings are packed into 4000 tokens unless project.yaml sets briefing.budget_tokens.

records.title: Agents forget project context between sessions
records.summary: The original problem: each new agent session starts blind and re-discovers decisions already made.
